title: Rusting and Corrosion
summary: Why iron gates, bicycles and ships rust, what rusting needs, and how paint, oil, galvanising and stainless steel protect them.

ib.note: Classic MYP Criterion B fair-test investigation

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 5: Changes Around Us: Physical and Chemical (rusting, galvanisation)
Ch 1 / Ch 3: corrosion and its prevention

objectives: I can state that iron needs both oxygen and water to rust.
I can design a fair test to find out what causes rusting.
I can explain several ways to prevent rusting and why each works.
I can evaluate the cost of corrosion to society.
misconceptions: Rust is just dirt on the surface of iron.
Iron rusts in dry air, or in water with no air.
All metals rust (rusting is the corrosion of iron specifically).
